synopsis: ISO 13849-1:2023 is the published fourth edition of the generic machinery functional-safety method for safety-related control systems, including software, using Performance Levels (PL) from a (lowest) to e (highest) [f2715, f2194, f15263, f12023]. It provides the PL method but does not assign the required level for collision-mitigation automatic braking; that must come from application-specific risk analysis or a type-C standard [f2195, f2350, f2716]. ISO 19014 is identified as the sector framework for earth-moving machines, while ISO 13849-1 remains relevant especially outside that scope or for subsystems developed under a generic framework [f12029, f2349]. A planning gap remains: Chapter 12 identifies ISO 13849-1:2023 and IEC 62061:2021 as current editions but reports that neither was reviewed [f9769].
